english.meaning: an older female cousin on the mother's side
english.note: Often used with 阿 as a title, like 阿表姐.

exampleSentences.english: My cousin said she wouldn’t. Going somewhere else won’t do, but she really likes going to Ling Ling’s place.
exampleSentences.traditional: 阿表姐話唔會喎。如果去第二度就唔得。但係好鍾意去阿玲玲嗰度𡃉喎。
